entities.name: UniProt Q3KR37 (GRAMD1B)
observations: The 738-aa query is an exact full-length sequence match to reviewed human Aster-B (UniProt Q3KR37).
Aster-B mediates non-vesicular cholesterol transfer, including plasma membrane-to-ER transfer; annotation also reports lysosome-to-ER transfer through NPC1 interaction.
Pfam detects a GRAM domain at residues 96–203 and a VASt domain at residues 376–523.
Annotated localization includes ER membrane, plasma membrane, and ER–plasma membrane contact sites; lipid conditions influence distribution.
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular mass 85.4 kDa, pI 5.84, GRAVY −0.69; these are computational estimates.
